Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sonali - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal feeds the birds.]

Sonali: "That's great!"

[Kunal does push-ups.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Kunal: "Mom, look over here."

[Kunal gets into the car.]

Kunal: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Sonali (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kunal: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Sonali: "What a day to remember!"
